criteria.description: 100 concurrent increments on one key end at exactly 100 (no lost updates).
A second burst of 50 concurrent increments brings the same key to exactly 150.
criteria.sourceExcerpt: 2. **Bursts compose.** A following burst of 50 concurrent increments must bring the value to 150.

criteria.description: Two different keys are counted independently under concurrent load.
criteria.sourceExcerpt: 3. **Per-key independence.** Different keys are counted independently and must not interfere.
